description: Update an existing transformation's expression, name, or description instead of creating another. Plans cap transformations per endpoint, so revising the one you have is the right move when a draft was wrong. Inputs: transformationId, an optional name, description, and expression, and projectId. Versioning is copy-on-write: when the latest version is frozen by a standing binding, the update FORKS a new draft, so check forkedNewVersion and re-bind with the returned latestVersionId. Materialize $install.NAME placeholders before saving; binding refuses an unmaterialized template. Read-write token.

expression.description: New JSONata expression over $body/$headers/$query/$secrets; omit to keep.

projectId.description: Opaque project id; omit to use the claimed or only project.

transformationId.description: Opaque id from create_transformation or the workspace, verbatim.

name: update_transformation
title: Update transformation
